You see Kalvin.

    Location

    Southeast of Venore Depot, second floor of the Dress for Success warehouse.

    Notes

    He informs you about various outfits. Apprentice of Hugo. His name is an allusion to Calvin Klein, a well-known American fashion designer.

    Transcripts

    To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Kalvin.

    Player: hi
    Kalvin: Be greeted, player! If you need information about outfits, I'm your man.
    Player: job
    Kalvin: I'm an apprentice of Hugo. My current task is to inform everyone about our summer collection.
    Player: collection
    Kalvin: We have designed many new dresses, cloaks, armors, hats, weapons... commonly referred to as outfits and addons.
    Player: name
    Kalvin: My name is Kalvin.
    Player: hugo
    Kalvin: I hope that one day I will have grand visions, too.
    Player: outfit
    Kalvin: Ah, I can tell you all about the newest range of patterns! There are, all in all, four free outfits, seven premium outfits, and nine quest outfits.
    Player: free outfit
    Kalvin: Well, we have the traditional knight outfit, the hunter outfit, the mage outfit and the citizen outfit. And, provided you find a partner, there is a newly wed outfit, too.
    Player: premium outfit
    Kalvin: Premium outfits are only available to characters on a premium account. They include the nobleman outfit, the summoner outfit, the warrior outfit, the barbarian outfit, the wizard outfit, the oriental outfit and the druid outfit.
    Player: quest outfit
    Kalvin: Quest outfits require certain tasks to be fulfilled before the outfit becomes accessible. Those quests are only available for premium customers. ...
    Kalvin: Currently, we have the following outfits: pirate, assassin, afflicted, beggar, deepling, warmaster, wayfarer, insectoid, crystal warlord, norseman ...
    Kalvin: As well as the elementalist, shaman, soil guardian, jester, demon, demon hunter, yalaharian, cave explorer, nightmare knight, brotherhood of bones, makeshift warrior and battlemage. ...
    Kalvin: As well as the discoverer, the fire-fighter, the ancient aucar, the decaying defender, the rootwalker, the dreamwarden, the falconer, the festive outfit, the glooth engineer, the percht raider or the poltergeist outfit. ...
    Kalvin: But also the outfits of the rascoohan, the revenant, the riftwarrior, the dreamwarrior, the hand of inquisition, the fiend slayer and of the illuminated warrior.
    Player: addons
    Kalvin: Addons are usually accessories. Each outfit has two addons which can be worn only together with this outfit. All addons have to be earned through quests.
    Player: quest
    Kalvin: Many addon quests require that a number of ingredients are collected.
    Player: Irmana
    Kalvin: <blushes> Such a beautiful and charming lady.
    Player: bye
    Kalvin: Good bye, player.

    About Outfits

    Player: knight
    Kalvin: If you spend your time fighting monsters and need that little extra protection, this well-armored outfit is great for you. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.
    Player: hunter
    Kalvin: A light and comfortable ranger outfit which every paladin simply loves to wear. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, a good place to start would be the paladin guild in Thais.
    Player: mage
    Kalvin: Great for wise old male mages as well as for pretty enchantresses. If you are looking to earn addons, ladies should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas elders should explore the Dark Cathedral.
    Player: citizen
    Kalvin: Your basic starter outfit - simple, but practical. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, you should walk around Thais and look for citizens wearing a hat or a backpack.
    Player: newly wed
    Kalvin: Pick a wedding partner and time and this outfit can be yours! Snow-white silk and lace for the glowing bride, including a veil and blossom circlet for that most special day. ...
    Kalvin: For the groom, a fine black frock-coat with brazen buttons, and white silk knee socks to lead your lady to the altar in style.
    Player: nobleman
    Kalvin: One of our finest pieces. If you have the money and wish to show how wealthy and noble you are, this is the outfit for you. We also create addons especially for you, right here.
    Player: summoner
    Kalvin: Great for young mages and ladies who love witchcraft. If you are looking to earn addons, gentlemen should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas ladies should explore the Dark Cathedral.
    Player: warrior
    Kalvin: The lighter version of the knight outfit is great if you want to save stamina and maintain agility. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.
    Player: barbarian
    Kalvin: This outfit stands for raw power, battle cries and lack of manners. I heard that there are a few barbarians living near Northport. They might just be able to provide fitting addons.
    Player: wizard
    Kalvin: Are you feeling evil today? This outfit is fitting for mages pursuing the dark side of sorcery. Shunned by the magic academy of Edron, you might find wizards hiding near Thais.
    Player: oriental
    Kalvin: This comfortable, yet fashionable outfit will create the romantic mood of Thousand and One Nights. A good place to look around for addons are naturally Darama and Ankrahmun.
    Player: druid
    Kalvin: Nature-loving and peaceful druids might like this outfit, especially the beastlike addons. I heard there is a druid living near Ab'Dendriel, who might be able to provide fitting addons.
    Player: pirate
    Kalvin: Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum! If you love the pirate way of life and sneer at landlubbers, this might be the right outfit for you. Pirates are said to roam the Shattered Isles...
    Player: assassin
    Kalvin: Mysterious and lethal, assassins are hard to find and almost impossible to befriend. I know of one assassin hiding away on the Daramian Plague Spire. If you are lucky, he won't kill you.
    Player: afflicted
    Kalvin: I heard it is the latest rage for all feverish citizens. Dropped by genuinely afflicted and specially tailored to your every need. Visit the swamp city of Venore if you fancy gaining this outfit.
    Player: beggar
    Kalvin: Ah, Hugo is working on designing this look. He might need some inspiration, so if you have some time to spare, don't hesitate to contribute some ideas to him.
    Player: deepling
    Kalvin: I have never laid eyes on one of those before. Notice the strage set of scale armor, crafted by long lost creatures of the deep. But beware, it is said that it has a life of its own - treat it carefully.
    Player: warmaster
    Kalvin: Styled after the exotic armors of the Lizardmen in the lands of faraway Zao. I heard you might get your hands on one if you help the dwarves establishing a mining base there.
    Player: insectoid
    Kalvin: Quite a buzz around this one, but you don't need a wasp waist to wear it! Comes with a mandible epaulette addon - Word is they wear this at the grey beach area, where they are fighting the insectoid hive.
    Player: crystal warlord
    Kalvin: A true warrior's attire! A striking armor and cloak, adorned with obsidian and crystals. You might want to visit the gnomes at Kazordoon if you wish to acquire this outfit. The hard part will be to earn their trust though.
    Player: norseman
    Kalvin: This cosy outfit will keep you warm in the deepest winters. The inhabitants of Svargrond use it to travel around their frozen islands.
    Player: elementalist
    Kalvin: With invisible air patterns and arcane sigils, it radiates that the wearer has the powers of the elements at his disposal. I believe you have to face a rogue mage near Edron to earn it.
    Player: shaman
    Kalvin: If you have seen everything and worn every look, this outfit will put the icing on your cake. Maybe you can earn it by becoming the apprentice of a shaman... or voodoo priest.
    Player: soil guardian
    Kalvin: Sometimes, the reclusive gnomes grant a dedicated helper the privilege to wear a special outfit like this one: the Soil Guardian. The riches of the Earth are shadowed out in the mushroom decor and the berg crystals embroidered. ...
    Kalvin: You might want to visit the gnomes at Kazordoon if you fancy this outfit. The hard part will be to earn their trust though.
    Player: jester
    Kalvin: You really want to look like a jester?? Well, then you should go visit Bozo. Maybe you are foolish enough to join his newly founded fools guild. Normally, you find him at the castle in Thais.
    Player: demon
    Kalvin: This garment is granted only after many a toil and if you defeated some nasty demons, I believe... you should talk to someone called Avar Tar about the details. You'll find him in Edron.
    Player: demon hunter
    Kalvin: I think the members of the inquisition award this outfit to their members when they have reached a certain rank. They hide somewhere under Thais.
    Player: yalaharian
    Kalvin: The people travel to Yalahar and come back with these fancy clothings. One of them told me that the Edron Academy is sending people to this ancient city.
    Player: cave explorer
    Kalvin: The practical attire for all who venture deep into the heart of the earth and a gnome's best friend: the cave explorer outfit! ...
    Kalvin: Handcrafted and awarded exclusively by the gnomes in the Spike to those who braved the dangers of the place and earned their gratitude.
    Player: nightmare
    Kalvin: This noble order vanished a long time ago. They were once located at the Plains of Havoc. Maybe you can find some hints about their remains if you go there. But be careful, it is a very dangerous area!
    Player: brotherhood
    Kalvin: They were the followers of Goshnar, the king of necromancy. They fought the Nightmare Knights without knowing any limits. It might be a foolish thing to look for them but if you are interested, the Plains of Havoc are a good start.
    Player: makeshift
    Kalvin: Necessity is the mother of invention! For most of us this is just trash, but combined in the right way it will become a more than veritable equipment. Look at the corym! They show us how it works!
    Player: battlemage
    Kalvin: Battlemages know how to combine arcane knowledge with wielding a sword. They often explore secret and dangerous sites of hidden or forgotten knowledge.
    Player: discoverer
    Kalvin: If you are interested in travelling and discovering the world of Tibia, this might be the perfect outfit for you. ...
    Kalvin: Whether you are visiting the dry Daramian deserts, the icy mountains of Hrodmir or the deep Tiquandan jungle, you will always be well prepared for every encounter and adventure.
    Player: fire
    Kalvin: If you want to become a hero by fighting raging flames you need to be dressed appropriately. ...
    Kalvin: This special outfit is rumored to be achieved by assisting the challenger expedition in Gnomprona - wherever that might be.
    Player: aucar
    Kalvin: Fighting like a proud ancient warrior of a lost culture like that surely requires a fitting attire. ...
    Kalvin: The only way must be to challenge such a warrior in the flesh, but that sounds impossible to me.
    Player: decaying
    Kalvin: The dark power of rot and decay may have been harvested by mighty beings throughout time and space but only true mastery will grant you the right to wear an outfit like that.
    Player: rootwalker
    Kalvin: Being one with a botanical being would require the will to live and feel the plant through and through, like a transformation from within.
    Player: dreamwarden
    Kalvin: As a dream warden, there is nothing you can't vanquish. Dreams, nightmares and illusions can't scare you anymore. Go to Roshamuul, if you desire such an outfit and search for it there.
    Player: falconer
    Kalvin: Don't let you Hunting Tasks Points go to waste, collect them of them and trade them in for an outfit worthy only for the most elite hunters.
    Player: festive
    Kalvin: If you want to wear those clothes, you have to meet the legendary First Dragon - and survive. That would be a reason to celebrate for sure.
    Player: glooth engineer
    Kalvin: The Rathleton Magistrate rewards people dedicated to their city with this outfit. If you can avert a dire threat for the city, it might be yours to wear.
    Player: percht
    Kalvin: Walking through the cold, icy darkness of winter as a denizen of frost... is this your thing? ...
    Kalvin: Then find and confront the percht during the twilight around the time the year is nearing its end.
    Player: poltergeist
    Kalvin: With this angst-inducing vestment you are able to wander around Tibia and scare many an unsuspecting wayfarer. But you have to defeat the dreaded Pale Worm first.
    Player: rascoohan
    Kalvin: There is an island named Rascacoon, and there you might find this outfit. Of course, you have to receive the Rascoohans' permission to wear it. Try to honour them with special gifts.
    Player: revenant
    Kalvin: If you defeat the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine ... then you might also look the part.
    Player: riftwarrior
    Kalvin: Go through hell. Seven times. Defeat the demons. Countless times. Put an end to Ferumbras' claims to ascendancy, once and for all. Then you may call yourself a rift warrior and dress appropriately.
    Player: dreamwarrior
    Kalvin: Dream Warriors defend the Dream Courts against unwanted intruders, be it from the real world or from the Nightmare Realms. Only rarely the dream elves grant the right to wear it to outsiders.
    Player: hand of inquisition
    Kalvin: The Inquisition grants this outfit only to their most trusted agents.
    Player: fiend slayer
    Kalvin: There are rumours about an ancient keep were such an outfit might be acquired through heroic deeds.
    Player: illuminated warrior
    Kalvin: A radiant outfit that can only be obtained in the distant kingdom of Thalassara by facing an enigmatic new god of Light.

    Kalvin
